file_contents.internal/store/users.go:
package store

import "database/sql"

func FindUser(db *sql.DB, name string) (*User, error) {
	query := "SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'"
	rows, err := db.Query(query)
	defer rows.Close()
	return nil, nil
}
